purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, bounded request outcomes, scope limits, and safe-field policy for Porlamar, Municipio Santiago Mariño, Nueva Esparta, Venezuela.
assessment: A local municipal cadastral/tax custodian and procedure are evidenced by the official SIGAT portal and urban-property materials, but no public parcel geometry, safe native parcel identity, schema/CRS, or anonymous parcel API was verified.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is based on the official municipal SIGAT portal's urban-property/inmueble procedures and linked contributor application. This is not evidence that the registry is openly downloadable or citywide geometrically accessible.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Municipio Santiago Mariño / Administración Tributaria del Municipio Mariño
officialPrimarySources.observation: Official municipal SIGAT portal; publishes urban-property and inmueble procedures and links to the contributor application.
Official portal copy of the municipal urban-property tax ordinance.
Official portal guide for registering inmuebles in Porlamar; procedural evidence only.

officialPrimarySources.operator: SIGAT contributor application linked by the municipal portal
officialPrimarySources.observation: Public Angular/OpenLayers application shell; current JavaScript disclosed the cadastral lookup path and authentication boundary.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: Angular application with OpenLayers 4.6.5 assets. Current bundle version 1.11.7 build 238 sets API base to /api/v1 and defines a contributor cadastral lookup service.
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: No parcel schema, native identifier field, CRS, or geometry response was verified. The bundle includes generic OpenLayers EPSG references, which are not evidence of the cadastral layer CRS.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

attempts.result: Official municipal SIGAT home page loaded; it linked urban-property ordinance/procedure documents and the contributor application.
Official urban-property ordinance PDF loaded; procedural/municipal registry evidence only. No owner/address/titleholder fields were extracted or retained.
Official inmueble-registration guide loaded; it is procedural evidence and does not provide a public parcel geometry layer.
Public contributor application shell loaded. OpenLayers dependency and current JavaScript bundle were inspected without login.

Current bundle disclosed API base /api/v1, app build 238, and GET /contribuyente/alcaldias/{alcaldia}/catastro?cod=... cadastral lookup service; no parcel response was requested from the bundle itself.

Anonymous bounded request denied with JSON code 103, 'No tiene acceso al recurso solicitado.' No geometry, schema, or native ID returned. No login, credentials, token, CAPTCHA, or unsafe lookup value was attempted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Municipio Santiago Mariño SIGAT sources and linked contributor application.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipal cadastral/tax procedure and authenticated lookup route evidenced; no open parcel layer or geometry verified.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying safe anonymous parcel response was verified.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A local municipal registry/procedure is evidenced, but no independent anonymous ID-plus-geometry response or qualified adapter source was found.

uncertainty: A restricted, authenticated, or offline municipal cadastral inventory may exist. Search non-result, the 403 access boundary, and absence of geometry do not prove citywide cadastral absence. Exact WUP point retained: [10.9695843946551, -63.8594882782306].
